name: Aerial Assault
summary: Each time a unit with the Deep Strike ability disembarks from this model after this model has made a Normal move, that unit makes an assault disembark move (Core Rules, 18.06) for that disembarkation.

name: Angel’s Wrath
summary: This unit adds 1 to its Advance rolls and its Charge rolls.

name: Annihilator
summary: Each time a ranged attack made by this model is allocated to a MONSTER or VEHICLE model, you can re-roll the Damage roll.

name: Annihilator Protocols
summary: Melee weapons of models in this unit gain Sustained Hits 2 when targeting Monster, Vehicle, or Fortification units.

name: Aquilon Optics
summary: When this unit makes ranged attacks that target a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, those attacks can re-roll one hit roll, re-roll one wound roll, and re-roll one damage roll.

name: Armorium Cherub
summary: Once per battle, after a Hit roll for a model in this unit, you can change that roll to an unmodified 6.

name: Armour of Faith
summary: Applies to attacks allocated to this model. Each such attack has -1 Damage.

name: Armoured Resilience
summary: Attacks allocated to this model have their Damage characteristic reduced by 1.

name: Assault Vehicle
summary: Units can disembark from this TRANSPORT after it has Advanced. Units that do so make a shock disembark move (Core Rules, 18.07) for that disembarkation.

name: Astartes Banner
summary: While this unit contains a Ravenwing Ancient, this unit has +1 OC.

name: Ballistus Strike
summary: Ranged attacks made by this unit against an enemy unit within 24" of this unit have [Sustained Hits 1].

name: Banner of the Emperor Victorious
summary: Add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for this unit.

name: Bladeguard
summary: Once per turn, in the Fight phase, when this unit is selected to fight or an enemy unit targets it, choose one: its melee attacks get +1 to hit, or attacks that target it get -1 to hit.

name: Blessing of the Omnissiah
summary: In your Command phase, you can select one friendly Grey Knights Vehicle model within 3" of this model. That model regains up to D3 lost wounds, and until the start of your next Command phase, each time that Vehicle model makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. Each model can only be selected for this ability once per turn.

name: Brutalis Charge
summary: After this model ends a Charge move, roll a D6 against one enemy unit within Engagement Range: 2-3 deals D3 mortal wounds, 4-5 deals 3, 6 deals D3+3.

name: Catechism of Fire
summary: In your Shooting phase, when this unit is selected to shoot, you can select one visible enemy unit. This unit's ranged attacks that target that unit have [Devastating Wounds].

name: Centurion Assault Launcher
summary: The bearer has the EXPLOSIVES keyword.

name: Ceramite Cover
summary: If a unit is not fully visible to the attacking model because of this unit, then when an attack targets that unit, the target has the benefit of cover against that attack.

name: CHOSEN OF THE EMPEROR
summary: Your army cannot include more than one model with this ability.

name: Close-quarters Firepower
summary: This unit's ranged attacks against the closest eligible target gain +1 Armour Penetration.

name: Column from the Major Altar
summary: Add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in this unit.

name: Combat Disembarkation
summary: A unit that disembarks from this model after it is set up on the battlefield remains eligible to declare a charge this turn.

name: Combat Squads
summary: At the start of the Declare Battle Formations step, before any units have been set up, this unit can be split into two units, each containing five models.

name: Combat Support
summary: Once per turn, in the opponent's Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Phobos Infantry unit within 6" of this model is selected as the target of an attack, one model from your army with this ability can use it. If it does, after that enemy unit has finished making its attacks, that model can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but when resolving those attacks it can only target that enemy unit, and only if it is an eligible target.

name: Command Squad
summary: Attacks that target this unit have -1 to wound rolls.

name: COMPANY HEROES
summary: A Captain or Chapter Master model must be attached to this unit, or it does not take part in the battle and counts as destroyed.

name: Condemnatory Annihilation
summary: After this unit has fought, if this unit destroyed an enemy model this phase, each enemy unit engaged with this unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

name: Crusade of Wrath
summary: This unit's melee attacks have +1 A and +1 S.

name: Deadly Terror
summary: While leading a unit, increase the range of that unit's Terror Troops ability by 3".

name: Decimator Protocols
summary: This unit's ranged attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1, or re-roll the whole Hit roll instead if the target is within range of an objective marker.

name: Deeds of Heroism
summary: Once per battle, when selected to fight, this model can give melee weapons of models in its unit +1 Attacks until the end of the phase.

name: Defensive Array
summary: This Fortification can be targeted with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem for 0CP once per turn, even if another unit was already targeted with it this turn.

name: Deployment Complete
summary: Once this Transport has deployed and all embarked units have disembarked, no unit may embark within it for the rest of the battle.

name: Designer’s Note
summary: Only the highlighted portions of this model count as making up its hull. Models can be set up on, or end a move on, any part of this model that is not highlighted in red. If any models are on non-highlighted sections of this model when it is destroyed, remove this model and then place those models as close to their original positions as possible on the battlefield.

name: Destructor
summary: This model's ranged attacks against Infantry units gain +1 Armour Penetration.

name: Drop Pod Assault
summary: This unit must start the battle in strategic reserves. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move. When this unit is set up, all units embarked within it must make a disembark/assault disembark move, and those units must be set up more than 8" away from all enemy units.

name: Duty Eternal
summary: Attacks that target this unit with a Strength characteristic greater than this unit's Toughness characteristic have -1 to wound rolls.

name: Evade and Survive
summary: In your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 8" of this model, if this model is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, this model can make a Normal move.

name: Exhortation of Rage
summary: While this unit is at or below half-strength, its melee attacks can re-roll wound rolls.

name: Exploit Their Cowardice
summary: When an enemy unit within this unit's Engagement Range Falls Back, if this unit then ends outside Engagement Range of all enemies, it can make a Normal move.

name: Faithful Cenobytes
summary: If this unit's Chaplain Grimaldus model is destroyed, this unit's remaining Cenobyte Servitor models are also destroyed. Each Cenobyte Servitor model in this unit takes up 0 transport capacity.

name: Fearsome Assault
summary: At the start of the Fight phase, enemy units within Engagement Range of a unit with this ability must take a Battle-shock test at -1.

name: Finest Hour
summary: Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, this model can add 3 Attacks to its melee weapons and give them Devastating Wounds until the end of the phase.

name: For the Chapter!
summary: When a model in this unit is destroyed, roll a D6: on a 3+ it can shoot after the attacker finishes before being removed from play, and any Hazardous tests taken for those attacks are automatically passed.

name: Gene-seed Recovery
summary: When this model's Bodyguard unit is destroyed, roll a D6: on a 2+ gain 1CP.

name: Grapnel Launcher
summary: The bearer's unit ignores vertical distance when determining the total distance moved during any move.

name: Guerrilla Tactics
summary: At the end of the opponent's turn, if this unit is more than 6" from all enemy models, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

name: Hailstrike
summary: In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units' ranged attacks that target that enemy unit have [IGNORES COVER].

name: Hammer of Wrath
summary: When this unit ends a charge move, you can select one enemy unit engaged with this unit. For each model in this unit engaged with that enemy unit, roll one D6. On a 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

name: Hammerstrike
summary: While this unit makes ranged attacks against an enemy unit that is within a terrain area, those attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

name: Haywire Mine
summary: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, target one enemy unit within 3" of the bearer and roll a D6: on a 2+ it suffers D3 mortal wounds (2D3 instead against a Vehicle).

name: Helix Gauntlet
summary: In your Command phase, this unit heals D3 wounds.

name: High Marshal
summary: At the start of the Fight phase, select up to one enemy unit engaged with this unit and roll one D6. On a 2-3, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. On a 4-5, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds. On a 6+, that enemy unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds.

name: Incendiary Terror
summary: After this unit shoots, pick one enemy Infantry unit hit by its pyreblaster attacks; that unit must take a Battle-shock test at -1.

name: Infiltrator Comms Array
summary: Each time the bearer's unit is targeted by a Stratagem, roll a D6: on a 5+ you gain 1CP.

name: Inspirational Exemplar
summary: Melee attacks made by this unit have +1 to hit rolls.

name: Interception Strike
summary: This model re-rolls Hit rolls on ranged attacks against enemy units within 12" of a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit.

name: Judgement of the Weak
summary: When a non-Monster/Vehicle enemy unit within this unit's Engagement Range Falls Back, it must take a Desperate Escape test, at -1 if it is Battle-shocked.

name: Keep the Banner High
summary: While leading a unit, if that unit is below Starting Strength its attacks get +1 to Hit; if Below Half-strength, +1 to Wound as well.

name: LAST SURVIVOR
summary: This model cannot be selected as your Warlord.

name: Legacy of Jerulas
summary: After this model shoots, pick one hit enemy unit; until the end of the turn, attacks against it from models that disembarked from this Transport this turn re-roll Hit and Wound rolls of 1.

name: Litanies of the Devout
summary: While this unit is leading a unit and contains a Chaplain Grimaldus model, each time a model in that led unit makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

name: Litany of Hate
summary: This unit's melee attacks have [Lance].

name: Martial Honour
summary: The first time this model's unit destroys an enemy unit with a melee attack, this model gains +5 Objective Control for the rest of the battle while its unit is not Battle-shocked.

name: Martial Honour (Once per battle, per unit)
summary: Once per battle, per unit. If this unit's melee attacks destroyed an enemy unit this phase, you can use this ability. If you do, until the end of the battle, this model has +5 OC.

name: Master of Deceit
summary: After deployment, if your army includes this model, redeploy up to three friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry units, optionally into Strategic Reserves beyond the normal limit.

name: Multi-spectrum Array
summary: After this unit shoots, mark one enemy unit it hit this phase; friendly Adeptus Astartes attacks against it get +1 to Hit for the rest of the phase.

name: Narthecium
summary: While this unit contains a Ravenwing Apothecary, in your Command phase, this unit heals D3+1 wounds.

name: Objective Secured
summary: If you control an objective marker at the end of your Command phase and this unit is in range of it, you keep control until the opponent controls it at the start or end of a turn, even with no models present.

name: Omni-scramblers
summary: In your Shooting phase, you can select one visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit. That unit is detected. While a unit is detected, that unit has +3" detection range.

name: Orbital Comms Array (Aura)
summary: Aura ability. While a friendly T'AU EMPIRE unit is within 6" of this FORTIFICATION, each time you target that unit with a Stratagem, roll one D6: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.

name: Outrider Escort
summary: Once per turn, in the opponent's Shooting phase, when another friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit within 6" of this model is selected as the target of an attack, one model from your army with this ability can use it. After that enemy unit finishes making its attacks, that model can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but those attacks can only target that enemy unit, and only if it is an eligible target.

name: Pious Fervour
summary: When this model's unit fights, its master-crafted power weapon gains +1 Attacks per enemy unit within 6" of this model (max +3) until the end of the phase.

name: Prioritised Eradication
summary: When a model in this model's unit destroys an enemy unit with a melee attack, roll a D6: on a 4+ gain 1CP.

name: Priority Objective Identified
summary: At the start of the first battle round, if your army includes one or more models with this ability, you can select one objective marker on the battlefield. Until the end of the battle, while one or more models with this ability are on the battlefield, each time a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES model makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is within range of that objective marker, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

name: Priority Target Acquisition
summary: This model's twin las-talon attacks against the closest eligible Monster or Vehicle get +1 to the Hit roll.

name: Reaping Tally
summary: This model's twin heavy onslaught gatling cannon gains Sustained Hits 2 against Infantry units.

name: Recitation of Faith
summary: While this model is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.

name: Refuse to Yield
summary: Attacks allocated to this model have -1 Damage.

name: Reiver Grav-chute
summary: The bearer has the Deep Strike ability.

name: Relic Shield
summary: This model has +1 to its Wounds (W) characteristic.

name: Remorseless Persecution
summary: In your Movement phase, when this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

name: Reposition Under Covering Fire
summary: In your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot, if it contains an Eliminator Sergeant equipped with an instigator bolt carbine, this unit can make a Normal move. If it does so, this unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

name: Righteous Zeal
summary: In the opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if a model in this unit was destroyed by those attacks, this unit can make a surge move of up to D6+1".

name: Rites of Battle
summary: Once per battle round, when a unit with this ability is targeted by a Stratagem, reduce that Stratagem's cost by 1CP.

name: Sentinel Protocols
summary: Each time this FORTIFICATION is selected for the Fire Overwatch Stratagem, hits are scored on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+ when resolving that Stratagem.

name: Shield Dome
summary: This unit has 5+ InSv.

name: Shock Assault
summary: This unit's melee attacks re-roll Wound rolls of 1, or re-roll the whole Wound roll instead if the target is within range of an objective marker.

name: Siege Shield
summary: This model's demolisher cannon can target enemy units within its own Engagement Range if no other friendly unit is also engaged with them, and this model ignores the ranged Hit roll penalty for being within Engagement Range.

name: Sigismund's Heir
summary: This unit adds 1 to its charge rolls.

name: Signum
summary: Each time this unit Remains Stationary, its ranged weapons gain the Ignores Cover ability until the start of your next Movement phase.

name: Silent Fury
summary: Each time this model destroys an enemy CHARACTER model, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its executioner relic blade until the end of the battle.

name: Spiritual Leader
summary: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, you can select one friendly GENESTEALER CULTS unit that is Battle-shocked and within 12" of this model. That unit is no longer Battle-shocked.

name: Stabilised Disembarkation
summary: In the opponent's Shooting phase, after this Transport is shot at, embarked units can disembark, setting up wholly within 6" of it and outside enemy Engagement Range.

name: Storm Shield
summary: This model has +1 W.

name: Strategic Dispersal
summary: After this model's unit shoots, if it is outside Engagement Range of all enemies, it can make a Normal move of up to 6"; if it does, it cannot declare a charge this turn.

name: Suppression Fire
summary: In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by this model's Twin Macro-accelerator Cannon weapon. That enemy unit is suppressed until the start of your next turn. While a unit is suppressed, that unit's attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

name: Surgical Precision
summary: While leading a unit, weapons equipped by models in that unit gain the Lethal Hits ability.

name: Tactical Precision
summary: This unit's attacks have the [Lethal Hits] ability when the target is not a MONSTER or VEHICLE.

name: Target Elimination
summary: When this unit is selected to shoot, its bolt rifles gain +2 Attacks for the phase, but all of the unit's attacks must target a single chosen enemy unit.

name: Target Priority
summary: This model's unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

name: Target Sighted
summary: At the start of your Shooting phase, pick one enemy unit visible to this model; friendly Adeptus Astartes Blast attacks against it get +1 to Hit and gain Ignores Cover for the phase.

name: Targeter Optics
summary: This unit's ranged attacks that target a visible enemy unit have [Ignores Cover].

name: Techmarine
summary: While within 3" of a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit, this model has the Lone Operative ability.

name: Teleport Homer
summary: At the start of the battle, you can set up one Teleport Homer token for this unit anywhere on the battlefield that is not in your opponent's deployment zone. If you do, then once per battle you can target this unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP. When resolving that Stratagem, you must set this unit up within 3" of that token and not within 8" of any enemy models. That token is then removed.

name: Temple Relics
summary: In your Command phase, if this unit includes a Cenobyte Servitor model, choose one Temple Relics ability for its Chaplain Grimaldus model to have until your next Command phase.

name: Tempormortis
summary: This unit has Fights First.

name: Terminator Storm Shield
summary: The bearer has a Wounds characteristic of 6.

name: Terminatus Assault
summary: If this unit made a charge move this turn, this unit's Lightning Claws weapons have [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle] and this unit's Thunder Hammer weapons have [Sustained Hits 1: Monster/Vehicle].

name: Terror Troops (Aura)
summary: While an enemy model is within 3" of this unit, that enemy model has -1 OC.

name: The Imperium’s Sword
summary: This model's unit can re-roll Charge rolls made for it.

name: Thunderhawk Cluster Bombs
summary: In your Movement phase, when this unit ends a normal/advance move, you can select one enemy unit this unit moved over during that move and roll six D6. For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

name: Thunderous Impact
summary: If this unit made a Charge move this turn, its melee attacks get +1 Strength and +1 Damage.

name: Thunderstrike
summary: This unit's ranged attacks that target a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit have +1 to wound rolls.

name: Total Obliteration
summary: This unit's ranged attacks can re-roll damage rolls.

name: Unbreakable Duty
summary: While within range of an objective marker or within 6" of the battlefield centre, this model has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

name: Unyielding in the Face of the Foe
summary: While this unit is controlling an objective, this unit has +1 to save rolls.

name: Vanguard Assault
summary: If this unit made a charge move this turn, this unit's melee attacks have +1 A.

name: Vehement Aggression
summary: In the Fight phase, when this unit is selected to fight, you can use this ability. If you do, make a leadership roll for this unit. Either this unit's melee attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1; or, if that roll succeeds, this unit's melee attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1 and can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

name: Vengeance of the Omnissiah
summary: When a friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle model is destroyed within 12" of this model, this model's Omnissian power axe has an Attacks characteristic of 7 until the end of the battle.

name: Vengeful Exhortation
summary: In the Fight phase, you can use this ability. If you do, when a model in this unit is destroyed, and this unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, that model is not removed from the battlefield. It is removed from the battlefield when this unit has fought, or at the end of the phase, whichever comes first.

name: Virtuous Onslaught
summary: This unit's attacks against the closest eligible target re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

name: Vivispectrum
summary: If this model's unit destroys an enemy unit with a melee attack, this model's Objective Control characteristic becomes 9 for the rest of the battle.

name: Water from the Stoup of Elucidation
summary: Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit get +1 Armour Penetration.

name: Wisdom of the Ancients (Aura)
summary: While a friendly Grey Knights Infantry unit is within 6" of this model, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
